item.title: Implement ledger.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated, verbatim): "Implement `ledger.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Goal: make ledger.py match SPEC.md in the repository root. Context: the existing tests cover only basics, so add focused tests for each specified error and boundary case. Constraints: Python standard library only; keep the documented API exactly as specified; keep functions under 60 lines and validate inputs at the boundary, failing visibly with the error types the spec names. Acceptance criteria: every behaviour, error and boundary case in SPEC.md has a test; the full test suite passes; the work is committed on the local branch and not pushed.

reasons: sizer: elevated -> high; capped at medium; consider a stronger tier; unchanged

Implemented ledger.py per SPEC.md and added focused tests, committed on archon/02aeax68-implement-ledger-py-per-spec-md-with-foc, not pushed. Head 4b0d00e, tree 7289cdb. Before: ledger.py raised NotImplementedError and both existing tests errored. After: `python3 -X dev -m unittest` runs 28 tests, all OK, three runs. The change uses one threading.Lock per ledger, so each operation is linearizable and opposite transfers cannot deadlock. Review: first reviewer failed two blocking test gaps (worker exceptions not failing the concurrency tests; no same-account validation test). Both were fixed in 4b0d00e with Review-Fix trailers. A delta reviewer confirmed both fixes by mutant testing and passed head 4b0d00e. Left open (non-blocking): _run_all catches Exception only, so a worker raising a BaseException subclass would not fail the test. Concurrency tests are timing-dependent; a 10 s join timeout guards against deadlock. No servers or processes were started by me. Judgment call: the stage rule about escalating concurrency work was not triggered, because the ledger is a new, isolated module with no callers in the repo.

pr.body: Approach: single threading.Lock per Ledger guards transfer and snapshot, so each operation is atomic and opposite transfers cannot deadlock. Amount is validated before account lookup; same-account transfers return True iff funds suffice and never change balances. Construction copies the input dict, then validates the copy; snapshot returns a copy. Key files: ledger.py, test_ledger.py. Checks: unittest suite 28/28 OK (dev mode, 3 runs). Review: first reviewer failed two test gaps, both fixed (Review-Fix trailers); delta reviewer passed head 4b0d00e. Assumptions: non-string account names are treated as unknown accounts (KeyError). Limits: concurrency tests are timing-dependent; a BaseException raised in a worker is not recorded (non-blocking follow-up).

pr.title: Implement Ledger per SPEC.md with focused tests

agt_01M8GNPHWFEGWSHKCTR88WGTFC:1.description: Concurrency tests cannot fail on worker-thread exceptions. _run_all only checks is_alive, so when every transfer raises RuntimeError inside a worker, test_opposite_transfers_do_not_deadlock and test_snapshots_never_see_half_a_transfer still report ok. The linearizability and no-deadlock evidence is therefore unreliable. Fix: have workers record exceptions and assert none occurred. at test_ledger.p

agt_01M8GNPHWFEGWSHKCTR88WGTFC:2.description: No test for same-account validation. SPEC says a same-account transfer must still validate the amount and account first, but SameAccountTransfer only covers funds and max balance. A mutant that returns before _check_accounts when source == destination (transfer('x','x',1) returns instead of raising KeyError) passes all 27 tests. Add a test that transfer('missing','missing',1) raises KeyError and t

agt_01M8GNPHWFEGWSHKCTR88WGTFC:3.description: BAD_BALANCES omits False, so the spec's 'booleans are not integers' rule is only tested for True when used as a balance. The code path is the same, so this is minor. at test_ledger.py:7

agt_01M8GNPHWFEGWSHKCTR88WGTFC:4.description: Constructor validates balances.items() and then copies with dict(balances). A caller that mutates its dict from another thread during construction could slip an unvalidated value into the copy. Copying first and then validating the copy removes the window. at ledger.py:30

agt_01M8GNS99KCFGZQWWK1CWMC6JW:1.description: Nit (non-blocking): _run_all's guarded wrapper catches Exception only, so a worker that raises a BaseException subclass (e.g. SystemExit) is not recorded and the test would not fail for that case. Not reachable from the ledger code under test. at test_ledger.py:176

risk.why: Concurrency/locking in ledger.py (new module, no callers in repo). Tests added: 28 unittest cases, timing-dependent concurrency tests with a 10 s join guard. Review: first reviewer blocking findings (test gaps) fixed; delta reviewer proposed low for the test-only delta, but high is kept per the rubric for concurrency/locking.
